Hardware wallet manufacturer Trezor provided an update on its investigation into hardware tampering involving devices sold by reseller CryptoBilis. On November 5, 2026, Strategy founder Michael Saylor joined Oranje Summit 2026 remotely. The event was held in São Paulo, Brazil. Saylor said frontier AI models make hackers more capable and that complex software used to move funds, including exchange and wallet software, is especially vulnerable. He argued that Bitcoin's design makes it resilient to AI threats and that Satoshi Nakamoto was right to limit its base-layer features because complex software expands the attack surface. He added that Bitcoin's computing power and security helped it win the race to become the global standard for digital capital. — link

Michael Saylor: Risk Is Hard to Predict, Keep the Option to Move Your Assets

On November 5, 2026, Strategy founder Michael Saylor joined Oranje Summit 2026 in São Paulo, Brazil, remotely. He said political conditions can change and that assets held for the long term should be both durable and portable. He pointed to real estate, which cannot be moved, and physical gold, which is difficult to transport. Bitcoin holders, he said, can choose to take self-custody, switch custodians, or move their assets to another jurisdiction. In his view, the option to move assets is what gives Bitcoin value. — link
